title: Three Days and One Short Ticket
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：platform　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 platform 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1995 the driver ① built the platform that no passenger in the station would have noted, and he said the building was the whole of the day. The ② platform, meaning the stage itself and not the ticket, ran three days and stayed unnoted in the book; a platform, he said, is the only thing in a station that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ platform in that station had the same short ticket beside it, and the ④ platform at the far platform, meaning the seat they kept for the children to book and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A platform, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the driver said the noting is the part that fills three days.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the platform was the whole of the matter, meaning the support and not the stage. The ⑥ platform, meaning the support and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; platform, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a stage and a support. He said the support is the part they remember.

By 2000 the ⑦ platform had become a line in a timetable, and the timetable had become an argument about the short ticket. The ⑧ platform of the whole thing, the driver wrote in February, was one station and three days of noting; platform, he said, is either the seat at the far platform or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ platform I remember is the stage noted in the timetable, which closed in 2002 and is still noted as the quietest in the station. A ⑩ platform, my mother said in 2004, is the only stage that improves by being noted; every platform, she said, is a support that has agreed to look like a stage. She said the support was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 平台；站台（指车站里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 平台；站台（指那座平台本身，与薄薄的车票相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the platform 搭这一座平台
D. n. 平台；站台（指留给孩子们订的那一个）
E. n. 平台之事（抽象总称，指一处车站的平台之事）
F. n. 平台；站台（指时刻表里写到、被记下的那一座）
G. n. 平台、依托（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 依托（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the platform that no passenger in the station would have noted
The platform, meaning the stage itself and not the ticket
the platform at the far platform
the platform was the whole of the matter
the platform had become a line in a timetable
The platform of the whole thing
A platform, my mother said in 2004

answers.why: build the platform 意为“搭这一座平台”，1995 年那位司机把车站里没有一位乘客肯记下的一座平台做了一遍。
platform 意为“平台；站台”，指那座平台本身而不是薄薄的车票，它经过了三个日子而在簿子上没有被记下。
platform 意为“平台；站台”，指车站里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一张薄薄的车票。
platform 意为“平台；站台”，指最远那座站台的留给孩子们订的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
platform 意为“平台、依托”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这座依托就是那件事的全部。
platform 意为“依托”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座平台，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
platform 意为“平台；站台”，指时刻表里写到、被记下的那一座，到 2000 年这一座成了时刻表里的一行。
platform 意为“平台之事”，司机二月写道，整件事的平台之事是一处车站和三个日子的记下。
platform 意为“平台；站台”，我记得的是时刻表里记下过的那一座，2002 年到站了，至今仍被说成车站里最安静的一座。
platform 为抽象总称，母亲 2004 年说，平台是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的平台。
